name: Databricks Run Now
description: Trigger an existing Databricks job by job_id via the real jobs.run_now API and wait for completion -- the Airflow DatabricksRunNowOperator equivalent.
author: Dagster Community

outputs.description: MaterializeResult with the Databricks run id, result state, and run page URL in metadata

job_id.description: Existing Databricks job id to trigger via run_now.
job_id.label: Job Id

workspace_token_env_var.description: Env var holding a Databricks personal access token (or workspace-scoped token).
workspace_token_env_var.label: Workspace Token Env Var

job_parameters.label: Job Parameters
job_parameters.description: Named job parameters (the modern run_now API) -- values are coerced to strings. Mutually independent of notebook_params/python_params.

notebook_params.label: Notebook Params
notebook_params.description: Notebook widget parameters, for jobs whose task is a notebook_task.

python_params.label: Python Params
python_params.description: Positional command-line parameters, for jobs whose task is a python/spark_python_task.

idempotency_token.label: Idempotency Token
idempotency_token.description: An idempotent run_now request with the same token and job_id returns the already-running/completed run instead of starting a new one.

poll_timeout_seconds.label: Poll Timeout Seconds
poll_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to wait for the job run to reach a terminal state before this asset itself raises a timeout error.

fail_on_non_success.label: Fail On Non Success
fail_on_non_success.description: Raise if the job run's result_state isn't SUCCESS. False materializes anyway with the result state in metadata.
